title: Code Skill Server: A Large-Scale Search Engine for Code Generation Skills
abstract: arXiv:2610.23186v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Agent skills have proven to be an effective technique for improving agent ability on specific tasks, including software engineering, natural science, and mathematics. During such a process, using agent skills often involves manually discovering and organizing skills from heterogeneous sources, while existing skill retrieval methods mainly focus on selecting relevant skills from established skill libraries. However, with the rapidly increasing number and variety of reusable agent skills, manually searching for relevant skills across heterogeneous sources is becoming impractical at scale. In this paper, we introduce the Code Skill Server (CSS), a large-scale search engine for finding the most useful code generation skills for a target task. CSS consists of a skill server that incrementally collects and indexes publicly available code generation skills from multiple sources, with 993 skills included in the corpus used in this work. translated_title: 代码技能服务器：面向代码生成技能的大规模搜索引擎
translated_abstract: 智能体技能已被证明是提升智能体在特定任务（包括软件工程、自然科学和数学）上能力的有效技术。在这一过程中，使用智能体技能通常需要从异构来源中手动发现和整理技能，而现有的技能检索方法主要侧重于从已有技能库中选取相关技能。然而，随着可复用智能体技能的数量和种类快速增长，在异构来源中手动搜索相关技能在大规模场景下已变得不切实际。在本文中，我们提出了代码技能服务器，这是一个大规模搜索引擎，用于为目标任务找到最有用的代码生成技能。CSS由一个技能服务器组成，该服务器从多个来源增量式地收集并索引公开可用的代码生成技能，本工作所用语料库中包含993个技能。
tldr: 提出了Code Skill Server（CSS），一个从多个异构来源增量收集并索引公开代码生成技能的大规模搜索引擎，能够自动为目标任务检索最有用的技能，解决了手动搜索技能在大规模场景下不可行的问题。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Code Skill Server (CSS), a large-scale search engine that incrementally collects and indexes publicly available code generation skills from heterogeneous sources, enabling automatic retrieval of the most useful skills for a target task and overcoming the impracticality of manual skill search at scale.
